ACT XXXV OF 2021
PUNJAB CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2021
An Act further to amend the Punjab Civil
Servants Act, 1974
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
29th October, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(119)/2021/2669, dated 29.10.2021.---The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 2021, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on October 27, 2021, and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on October 28, 2021, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary further to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of
1974) for the purpose of modifying provisions relating to retirement of civil
servants.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) This
Act shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 12 of Act VIII of 1974

by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on October 27, 2021, and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on October 28, 2021, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary further to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of
1974) for the purpose of modifying provisions relating to retirement of civil
servants.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 12 of Act VIII of 1974.---In
the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974), in section 12, in
subsection (1), for clause (ii), the following shall be substituted:
"(ii)
where no direction is given under clause (i):
(a) on
completion of sixtieth year of his age; or
(b) voluntarily,
on completion of twenty five years of service or on attaining fifty five years
of age, whichever is later.".

Repeal
